question: नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा कुन हो?
answer: नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा देवनागरी लिपिमा लेखिएको नेपाली भाषा हो। यसले प्रदेश सरकारले आफ्नो प्रदेशमा बहुसंख्यक जनताले बोल्ने अन्य राष्ट्रभाषा प्रयोग गर्न अनुमति दिन्छ। (धारा ७)

question: What is the official language of Nepal?
answer: The official language of Nepal is the Nepali language in the Devnagari script. However, provinces can also designate other languages spoken by a majority of their population as official languages alongside Nepali. (Article 7)

question: प्रधान न्यायाधीशलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
answer:
प्रधानन्यायपतिको नियुक्तिको सिफारिस संवैधानिक परिषदले गर्छ। यसमा प्रधानमन्त्री अध्यक्ष रहन्छन् र प्रधानन्यायपतिको सदस्य पनि हुन्छन्।
(धारा १२९, धारा १४०, धारा १४३)
notes: incomplete: says Constitutional Council recommends but omits that the President appoints (Art 129(2))

question: Who appoints the Chief Justice of Nepal?
answer:
The Chief Justice of Nepal is appointed through a multi-step process involving several key entities. Initially, the Constitutional Council makes a recommendation based on the advice of the Judicial Council, and then the President formally appoints the Chief Justice. This process ensures a balance of legal expertise and executive authority in determining the head of the judiciary.

(Article 129)
(Article 140)
(Article 154)
(Article 284)

question: धारा २९ मा के व्यवस्था छ?
answer: धारा २९ मा प्रत्येक व्यक्तिलाई शोषण विरुद्धको हक हुनेछ भनी व्यवस्था छ। यसमा धर्म, प्रथा, परम्परा, संस्कार, प्रचलन वा अन्य कुनै आधारमा कुनै पनि व्यक्तिलाई कुनै किसिमले शोषण गर्न पाइने छैन भनी उल्लेख छ। साथसाथै, बेचबिखन, दास वा बाँधा बनाउन र कसैलाई निजको इच्छा विरुद्ध काममा लगाउन निषिद्ध छ। (धारा २९)

question: What does Article 29 say?
answer: Article 29 states that every person has the right against exploitation. No person shall be exploited on the grounds of religion, custom, tradition, usage, practice, or any other grounds. No one shall be subjected to trafficking, slavery, or servitude, and no one shall be forced to work against their will. (Article 29)

question: कसैलाई उसको इच्छा विपरीत जबरजस्ती काममा लगाउन पाइन्छ?
answer:
नयाँ प्रश्नको उत्तर यस प्रकार छ: कसैलाई उसको इच्छा विपरीत जबरजस्ती काममा लगाउन पाइँदैन। राज्यले यसको व्यवस्था निरुद्धार गरेको छ। यस विषयमा धारा २९(४) मा व्यवस्था छ।

(धारा २९)

question: Can a person be forced to work against their will?
answer:
According to Article 29(4), no one shall be forced to work against their will. This article specifically addresses the right to freedom from forced labor. 

(धारा २९(४))

question: नेपालमा न्यूनतम ज्याला कति छ?
answer:
माफ गर्नुहोस्, तर यो प्रश्नको जवाफ संविधानको अंशहरूमा फेला परेन। 

संविधानमा यस सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था फेला परेन।

question: What is the minimum wage in Nepal?
answer: The Constitution of Nepal does not explicitly state a minimum wage. Instead, it outlines how the remuneration for various officials and the Auditor General will be determined through federal law and government specifications until those laws are enacted. (Article 72), (Article 79), (Article 108), (Article 240)

question: प्रहरीले पक्राउ गरेपछि कति घण्टाभित्र अदालतमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
answer: प्रहरीले पक्राउ गरेपछि चौबीस घण्टाभित्र अदालतमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ। धारा २० अनुसार, पक्राउमा परेका व्यक्तिलाई पक्राउ परेको समयदेखि नै आफूले रोजेको कानून व्यवसायीसँग सल्लाह लिन पाउने तथा कानून व्यवसायीद्वारा पुर्पक्ष गर्ने हक हुनेछ। धारा २० अनुसार, पक्राउ गरिएको व्यक्तिलाई पक्राउ भएको समय तथा स्थानबाट बाटोको म्याद बाहेक चौबीस घण्टाभित्र मुद्दा हेर्न अधिकारी समक्ष उपस्थित गराउनु पर्नेछ।

question: How soon after arrest must police bring a person before a court?
answer: Within twenty-four hours of arrest, excluding the time necessary for the journey from the place of arrest to the adjudicating authority. (Article 20)

question: नेपालमा मृत्युदण्डको सजाय दिन मिल्छ?
answer:
संविधानमा यस सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था फेला परेन।
(धारा १६)
notes: refused wrongly: Art 16(2) bars any law providing death penalty

question: Does the Constitution allow the death penalty?
answer:
No, the Constitution of Nepal does not allow the death penalty. Article 16 explicitly states that no law shall be made providing for the death penalty to anyone.

(धारा १६)

question: सरकारले पत्रिकाको समाचार छाप्नुअघि रोक्न सक्छ?
answer: सरकारले पत्रिकाको समाचार छाप्नुअघि रोक्न सक्दैन। यस उपधारामा लेखिएको कुनै कुराले रेडियो, टेलिभिजन, अनलाइन वा अन्य कुनै किसिमको डिजिटल वा विद्युतीय उपकरण, छापाखाना वा अन्य सञ्चार माध्यमको नियमन गर्न ऐन बनाउन बन्देज लगाएको मानिने छैन (धारा १९(२))। तर, यस उपधारामा लेखिएको कुराले नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, राष्ट्रियता वा संघीय इकाइबीचको सु--सम्बन्ध वा विभिन्न जात, जाति, धर्म वा सम्प्रदाय बीचको सु--सम्बन्धमा खलल पर्ने, राज्यद्रोह, गाली बेइज्जती वा अदालतको अवहेलना हुने वा अपराध गर्न दुरुत्साहन गर्ने वा सार्वजनिक शिष्टाचार, नैतिकताको प्रतिकूल कार्य गर्ने, श्रमप्रति अवहेलना गर्ने र जातीय छुवाछुत एवं लैङ्गिक भेदभावलाई दुरुत्साहन गर्ने कार्यमा मनासिब प्रतिबन्ध लगाउने गरी ऐन बनाउन रोक लगाएको मानिनेछ (धारा १९(१))।
notes: core answer right, but inverts 19(1) proviso (says restrictions law is barred; text says reasonable restrictions are allowed)

question: Can the government censor news before it is published?
answer:
No, the government cannot censor news before it is published. Article 19(1) of the Constitution of Nepal states that no publication and broadcasting or dissemination or printing of any news item shall be censored. 

(Article 19(1))

question: सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धी संविधानमा के व्यवस्था छ?
answer: संविधानको धारा २७ अनुसार प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आफ्नो वा सार्वजनिक सरोकारको कुनै पनि विषयमा सूचना माग्ने र पाउने अधिकार छ। यसको अर्थ यो हो कि, यदि कसैलाई कुनै सार्वजनिक विषयमा रुची छ भने उनी सूचना मागेर पाउन सक्छन्। यस विषयमा, धारा २७ (धारा २७) उल्लेख गरिएको छ।

question: What does the Constitution say about the right to information?
answer:
The Constitution of Nepal guarantees every citizen the right to demand and receive information regarding matters of personal or public interest. However, this right is limited by the need to maintain confidentiality as dictated by law. This right to information is further protected through Article 27.

(Article 27)

question: सरकारी विद्यालयमा कुन तहसम्म निःशुल्क पढ्न पाइन्छ?
answer: सरकारी विद्यालयमा माध्यमिक तहसम्म निःशुल्क पढ्न पाइन्छ। (धारा ३१ (२))

question: Up to what level is education free in public schools?
answer: Education is free up to the secondary level in public schools, ensuring all citizens have access to this fundamental right. The Constitution states that every citizen has the right to get compulsory and free education up to the basic level and free education up to the secondary level from the State. (धारा ३१ (२))

question: सरकारी अस्पतालमा आधारभूत उपचार निःशुल्क पाइन्छ?
answer: राज्यले प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवा निःशुल्क प्राप्त गर्न दिन्छ। यसको व्यवस्था धारा ३५(१) मा स्पष्ट छ। यो सुनिश्चित गर्दछ कि कसैलाई आकस्मिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाबाट वञ्चित गरिने छैन। (धारा ३५(१))

question: Are basic health services provided free of cost?
answer: Yes, every citizen has the right to receive basic health services from the State free of charge. This right includes both regular and emergency healthcare, ensuring no one is denied access to these essential services. (धारा ३५ (१))
notes: wrong detail added: puts emergency care under the free right; Art 35(1) makes only basic services free, and says no one shall be deprived of emergency services

question: सरकारले कसैको जग्गा लिँदा मुआब्जा दिनुपर्छ?
answer: सरकारले कुनै व्यक्तिको सम्पत्ति अधिग्रहण गर्दा क्षतिपूर्तिको आधार र कार्यप्रणाली ऐन बमोजिम हुनेछ (धारा २५(३))। यो उपधाराको प्रयोजनमा “सम्पत्ति” भन्नाले चल अचल लगायत सबै प्रकारको सम्पत्ति सम्झन् पर्छ र सो शब्दले बौद्धिक सम्पत्ति समेतलाई जनाउँछ (धारा २५(१))।

question: Must the state pay compensation when it acquires someone's land?
answer:
The State shall not, except for public interest, requisition, acquire, or otherwise create any encumbrance on, property of a person. Provided that this clause shall not apply to any property acquired by any person illicitly. (2) 

(धारा २५ (२))

question: राष्ट्रपतिको पदावधि कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
answer: राष्ट्रपतिको पदावधि निर्वाचित भएको मितिले पाँच वर्ष हुन्छ। यस संविधान अनुसार, राष्ट्रपतिको पदावधि पाँच वर्षको हुन्छ जुन निर्वाचित भएको मितिले सुरु हुन्छ। (धारा ६३)

question: What is the term of office of the President?
answer: The President’s term of office is five years from the date of their election. The President continues to discharge their functions until a new President is elected. (Article 63)

question: राष्ट्रपति हुन कम्तीमा कति वर्ष उमेर पुगेको हुनुपर्छ?
answer: राष्ट्रपति हुनका लागि कम्तीमा ४५ वर्ष उमेर पुगिसक्यो हुनुपर्छ। यस धारामा राष्ट्रपतिको योग्यताको स्पष्ट उल्लेख छ जहाँ ४५ वर्ष पुगिसक्यो भनिएको छ। (धारा ६४)

question: What is the minimum age to become President?
answer: The minimum age to become President is forty-five years. This requirement is outlined in Article 64(1)(b) of the Constitution. (धारा ६४(१)(ख))

question: प्रधानमन्त्री कसरी नियुक्त हुन्छ?
answer: प्रधानमन्त्रीलाई नियुक्त गर्ने प्रक्रिया केही चरणहरूबाट हुन्छ। सर्वप्रथम, प्रतिनिधि सभामा बहुमत प्राप्त संसदीय दलको नेतालाई राष्ट्रपति नियुक्त गर्नेछन्। यदि कुनै दलले स्पष्ट बहुमत नपाउँदा, दुई वा दुई भन्दा बढी दलको समर्थनमा बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्ने सदस्यलाई राष्ट्रपति नियुक्त गर्नेछन्। यदि उपधारा (२) वा (३) बमोजिम नियुक्त प्रधानमन्त्रीले विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गर्न नसकेमा, राष्ट्रपति प्रतिनिधि सभामा सबैभन्दा बढी सदस्यहरू भएको दलको संसदीय दलको नेतालाई नियुक्त गर्नेछन्। (धारा ७६)

question: How is the Prime Minister appointed?
answer:
The Prime Minister is appointed in a series of steps outlined in the Constitution. Initially, the President appoints the leader of the parliamentary party commanding a majority in the House of Representatives (Article 76). If no single party has a majority, the President appoints a member able to command a majority with the support of two or more parties (Article 76). If the Prime Minister cannot be appointed within thirty days or fails a vote of confidence, the President appoints the leader of the party with the highest number of members (Article 76). Finally, the Council of Ministers is constituted under the President’s chairpersonship, with a maximum of twenty-five Ministers (Article 76).

(Article 76)
(Article 298)

question: प्रतिनिधि सभामा जम्मा कति सदस्य हुन्छन्?
answer: प्रतिनिधि सभामा जम्मा दुई सय पचहत्तर सदस्य हुन्छन्। (धारा ८४)

question: How many members are there in the House of Representatives?
answer: The House of Representatives consists of a total of two hundred and seventy-five members. This number is divided into one hundred and sixty-five members elected through a first-past-the-post system and one hundred and ten members elected through a proportional electoral system. (Article 84)

question: राष्ट्रिय सभामा कति सदस्य रहन्छन्?
answer: राष्ट्रिय सभामा कुल ५९ सदस्य रहनेछन्। यो धारा ८६ मा उल्लेख गरिएको छ। (धारा ८६)

question: How many members does the National Assembly have?
answer: The National Assembly shall consist of fifty-nine members as follows: - (a) Fifty six elected members consisting of at least three women, one Dalit and one from persons with disabilities or minorities, from each Province by an electoral college consisting of members of the Provincial Assembly, chairpersons and vice-chairpersons of the Rural Municipalities, and Mayors and Deputy-Mayors of the Municipalities, with different weightage of vote by members of the Provincial Assembly, chairpersons and vice-chairpersons of the Rural Municipalities, and Mayors and Deputy-Mayors of the Municipalities, as provided for in the federal law, (b) Three members consisting of at least one woman nominated by the President on the recommendation of the Government of Nepal. (Article 86)

question: सांसद बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति चाहिन्छ?
answer: सांसद बन्न कम्तीमा प्रतिनिधि सभाका लागि पच्चीस वर्ष र राष्ट्रिय सभाका लागि पैंतीस वर्षको आवश्यकता हुन्छ। धारा ८७ अनुसार, प्रतिनिधि सभाका लागि न्यूनतम उमेर पच्चीस वर्ष छ भने राष्ट्रिय सभाका लागि न्यूनतम उमेर पैंतीस वर्ष छ। धारा ८७, धारा ८४।

question: What is the minimum age to become a member of parliament?
answer:
To become a member of parliament, a person must be at least twenty-five years old for the House of Representatives and thirty-five years old for the National Assembly. 

(Article 87)
(Article 178)

question: उच्च अदालतको मुख्य न्यायाधीश कसरी नियुक्त हुन्छ?
answer: उच्च अदालतको मुख्य न्यायाधीशको नियुक्ति प्रधान न्यायाधीशले न्याय परिषदको सिफारिसमा गर्छन्। यसको अलावा, कानूनमा स्नातक उपाधि प्राप्त गरी जिल्ला न्यायाधीशको पदमा कम्तीमा पाँच वर्ष काम गरेको वा कानूनमा स्नातक उपाधि प्राप्त गरी वरिष्ठ अधिवक्ता वा ८ अधिवक्ताको रूपमा कम्तीमा दश वर्ष निरन्तर वकालत गरेको वा कम्तीमा दश वर्ष कानूनको अध्यापन, अन्वेषण वा कानून वा न्याय सम्बन्धी अन्य कुनै क्षेत्रमा निरन्तर काम गरेको वा न्याय सेवाको कम्तीमा राजपत्रांकित प्रथम श्रेणीको पदमा कम्तीमा पाँच वर्ष काम गरेको व्यक्तिहरू पनि नियुक्तिका लागि योग्य हुन्छन्। (धारा १४०)

question: How is the Chief Judge of a High Court appointed?
answer: The Chief Judge of a High Court is appointed on the recommendation of the Judicial Council. Any citizen of Nepal who has obtained a bachelor’s degree in law and served as a Judge of a District Court for at least five years or who has obtained a bachelor’s degree in law and constantly practised law as a senior advocate or advocate for at least ten years or who has constantly been engaged in the teaching or research of law or in any other field relation to law or justice for at least ten years or who has served in the post of at least Gazetted first class of the Judicial Service for at least five years shall be deemed to be eligible for appointment as the Chief Judge or a Judge of the High Court. (Article 140)

question: नेपालमा कति वटा प्रदेश छन्?
answer: नेपालमा कति वटा प्रदेश छन् भन्ने कुरा संविधानको धारा ५६ अनुसार तीन तहको संरचना छ: संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तह। धारा ५६ मा प्रदेशको संख्याको स्पष्ट उल्लेख छैन, तर धारा २९५ मा संघीय आयोगको गठनले प्रदेशको सीमांकन सम्बन्धी सुझाव दिने व्यवस्था छ। (धारा ५६)

question: How many provinces does Nepal have?
answer:
Nepal currently has three levels of state power: the Federation, the Provinces, and the Local Levels. Article 56 states that Provinces consist of the Districts listed in Schedule-4, and at the time of commencement, there were three Provinces. Furthermore, Article 295 discusses the formation of Provinces, suggesting a framework for establishing them.

(Article 56)
(Article 295)

question: गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको अधिकार कहाँ तोकिएको छ?
answer:
गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको अधिकार संविधानको विभिन्न भागहरूमा तोकिएको छ, विशेष गरी स्थानीय कार्यपालिका र स्थानीय व्यवस्थापिकाको सम्बन्धमा। यी निकायहरूको अधिकार अनुसूची-८ र अनुसूची-९ बमोज्य निर्धारण गरिएको छ। यसको अतिरिक्त, गाउँ सभा र नगर सभाले पनि अधिकार प्रयोग गर्छन्।

(धारा २१४, धारा २२१, धारा २३०)

question: Where are the powers of local governments defined?
answer:
The powers of local governments are defined in several articles of the Constitution, primarily through the establishment of the Rural Municipal Executive and Municipal Executive, as well as the Rural Municipal Assembly and Municipal Assembly. These powers are detailed in Schedules 8, 9, and 9, outlining the specific competencies and responsibilities of each level of local government. (Articles 214, 221, 57, and 59) 

(Article 214), (Article 221), (Article 57), (Article 59)

question: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग कसरी गठन हुन्छ र यसले के काम गर्छ?
answer: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग नेपालमा एक अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग रहनेछ जसमा प्रमुख आयुक्त र अन्य चार जना आयुक्तहरू रहनेछन् । प्रमुख आयुक्तले अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोगको अध्यक्ष भई काम गर्नेछ । (धारा २३८) यस आयोगले भ्रष्टाचार गरी अख्तियारको दुरुपयोग गरेको सम्बन्धमा कानून बमोजिम अनुसन्धान गर्न वा गराउन सक्नेछ । (धारा २३९)

question: How is the CIAA formed and what does it do?
answer: The Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA) is formed by continuing the officials who were holding office at the time of the Constitution’s commencement, subject to the number specified in the Constitution. It conducts investigations of any abuse of authority committed through corruption by any person holding public office. (धारा ३०१)

question: देशमा ठूलो प्राकृतिक प्रकोप आएमा राष्ट्रपतिले के गर्न सक्छ?
answer: नेपालमा ठूलो प्राकृतिक प्रकोप आएमा राष्ट्रपतिले प्रदेशमा गम्भीर सङ्कट उत्पन्न भएमा सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सरकारले नेपाल सरकार समक्ष यस धारा बमोजिम प्रदेश वा प्रदेशको कुनै भागमा सङ्गटकालीन अवस्थाको घोषणा वा आदेश जारी गर्नका लागि अनुरोध गर्न सक्नेछ (धारा २७३(२))। यदि प्रदेश सरकारले यस्तो अनुरोध गर्छ भने राष्ट्रपतिले सङ्गटकालीन अवस्थाको घोषणा गर्न सक्नेछ।

question: What can the President do if a major natural disaster strikes the country?
answer: If a major natural disaster strikes the country, the President can declare a state of emergency in respect of the whole of Nepal or of any particular part thereof. Furthermore, the concerned Provincial Government can request the Government of Nepal to declare a state of emergency in respect of the whole of the Province or of any specified part thereof. (Article 273)

question: धारा २७४ के बारेमा हो?
answer: धारा २७४ संविधान संशोधनको बारेमा हो। यसले संविधान संशोधन गर्ने प्रक्रियाको बारेमा नियमन गर्दछ, जसमा विधेयकको पेशावचन, सार्वजनिक प्रकाशन, प्रदेश सभाको सहभागिता र स्वीकृतिको आवश्यकता समावेश छ।

question: What is Article 274 about?
answer:
Article 274 is about the amendment to the Constitution. It outlines the process for amending the Constitution, including restrictions on amending certain clauses and the procedures for introducing, publishing, and obtaining consent from Provincial Assemblies. 

(Article 274)

question: धारा ५१ मा के छ?
answer: धारा ५१ मा राज्यका नीतिहरू छन्। यसमा राष्ट्रिय एकता र राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा सम्बन्धी नीतिहरू समावेश छन्, जसमध्ये राष्ट्रको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता र स्वाधीनताको संरक्षण गर्ने, विभिन्न जात, जाति, धर्म, भाषा, संस्कृति र सम्प्रदायबीच सद्भाव कायम गर्ने, र राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा प्रणालीको विकास गर्ने कुरा बताइएको छ। (धारा ५१)

question: What does Article 51 contain?
answer:
Article 51 outlines the policies the State of Nepal will pursue, focusing on national unity, security, and human security. It details specific measures to maintain national cohesion, develop a competent security system, and prepare citizens for national service. Furthermore, it addresses the need for harmonious relations between the Federal Units.

(Article 51)

question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल कुन हो?
answer:
नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल लालीगुराँस हो। यसको बारेमा धारा ९ मा व्यवस्था गरिएको छ। 

(धारा ९)

question: What is the national flower of Nepal?
answer: The national flower of Nepal is the Rhododendron Arboreum. This flower is specifically designated as the national flower in Article 3 of the Constitution. (धारा ३)

question: नेपाली सेना परिचालन गर्ने निर्णय कसले गर्छ?
answer: नेपाली सेना परिचालन गर्ने निर्णय राष्ट्रपतिले राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषदको सिफारिशमा नेपाल सरकार, मन्त्रिपरिषद्को निर्णय बमोजिम गर्नेछ। (धारा २६७)

question: Who decides to mobilize the Nepal Army?
answer:
The mobilization of the Nepal Army is determined through a multi-step process involving several key actors within the government. Initially, the Government of Nepal, in conjunction with the Council of Ministers and the recommendation of the National Security Council, makes the decision to mobilize the army. Subsequently, the House of Representatives must approve this declaration within one month. 

(Article 267)

question: विदेशमा बस्ने नेपालीले कस्तो नागरिकता पाउन सक्छन्?
answer: विदेशी मुलुकको नागरिकता प्राप्त गरेको दक्षिण एशियाली क्षेत्रीय सहयोग सङ्गठनको सदस्य राष्ट्र बाहेकका देशमा बसोबास गरेको साबिकमा वंशजको वा जन्मको आधारमा निज वा निजको बाबु वा आमा, बाजे वा बज्यै नेपालको नागरिक रही पछि विदेशी मुलुकको नागरिकता प्राप्त गरेको व्यक्तिलाई संघीय कानून बमोजिम आर्थिक, सामाजिक र सांस्कृतिक अधिकार उपभोग गर्न पाउने गरी नेपालको गैरआवासीय नागरिकता प्रदान गर्न सकिनेछ (धारा १४)।

question: What kind of citizenship can Nepalis living abroad get?
answer:
Non-resident Nepali citizenship can be granted to individuals who have acquired citizenship of a foreign country, have resided outside of South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation countries, and have a familial connection to Nepal through descent. This citizenship grants them economic, social, and cultural rights within Nepal, as defined by federal law. (Article 14)

question: What is the income tax rate in Nepal?
answer:
The Constitution of Nepal does not specify a particular income tax rate. Instead, it outlines the legal framework for levying and collecting taxes, emphasizing that such actions must be conducted in accordance with established laws and regulations. The Constitution delegates the authority to determine tax rates to the Government of Nepal, operating within the parameters set by federal law.
